* **0 - 2 hours** - use immediately or refrigerate
* **2 - 4 hours** - use immediately or do not refrigerate
* **after 4 hours** - do not use or discard

content: Soldiers must be **monitored strictly** as it is our main product and mainly stays within the Danger Zone temperatures of between 5°C to 60°C.
The **2/4-hour rule** is applied as soon as the Soldier ingredients are in the Danger Zone.
This includes the **time **that it takes to **roll** the Soldiers.
The **maximum **holding time of soldiers is **8 hours** (including 4 hours in a refrigeration unit and 4 hours exposed to the Danger Zone temperatures).
data.title: <sb>Soldiers Holding Times</sb>

content.content: ## **Note**: The total holding time of BBQ Chicken is 8 hours (including both displays and refrigerate time). It will ensure the high quality of Soldiers is maintained. ## For night trading stores, the second round of rolling must be organised between 2:00 pm – 5:00 pm to prepare for dinner service instead of rolling all Soldiers in the morning only. ---- ## Example 2: Prawn

## **Note**: After rolling, total time in Danger Zone is under 2 hours, hence why the Prawn itself and Pork & Prawn Soldiers are allowed to refrigerate. It is also applied to products on display.  


## If the product is in Danger Zone for over 2 hours, it must be used immediately (DO NOT refrigerate).
